review: 202.2f-1: variant already_colorless changed two facts (spell and target) and was not a real does_not_fire case, and added_color was marked other although blue is added; replaced already_colorless with a no-cast does_not_fire variant and set added_color to fires.

202.3f-1: the only does_not_fire variant changed the cast spell, so nothing isolated the hybrid symbol counting as 2 rather than as the 1 mana paid; added variant revealed_spent_amount revealing Gray Ogre (mana value 3), which leaves Beseech the Queen uncountered.

scenarios.title: A spell can be cast only when the mana spent matches the colored symbols and covers the generic part of its mana cost
decisions: A considers casting Grizzly Bears ({1}{G}) with the untapped lands A controls; the verdict is read before any mana is spent.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting Grizzly Bears is legal: Forest pays {G} and Mountain pays the generic {1}.

variants.label: wrong_colors
variants.delta: A controls Mountain and Mountain instead of Forest and Mountain.
variants.expected: Casting Grizzly Bears is not legal: two mana are available but none is green.

variants.label: too_little_mana
variants.delta: A controls only Forest; the Mountain is absent.
variants.expected: Casting Grizzly Bears is not legal: the one available mana covers {G} but not the generic {1}.

scenarios.title: A card with no mana cost cannot be cast from hand by paying its mana cost

setup.notes: Ancestral Vision has no mana cost (it has suspend, which is a special action rather than casting).

decisions: A considers casting the candidate card from hand with three untapped Islands available; the verdict is read before any mana is spent. The candidate in the base variant is Ancestral Vision.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting Ancestral Vision from hand is not legal: it has no mana cost, which is an unpayable cost, even with three untapped Islands.

variants.label: with_mana_cost
variants.delta: The candidate is Divination ({2}{U}) instead of Ancestral Vision.
variants.expected: Casting Divination is legal: its mana cost is payable with the three Islands.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge treats a card with ManaCost:no cost as uncastable from hand; its suspend ability is the only way to play it from hand.

scenarios.title: An object's colors are the colors of the mana symbols in its mana cost, whatever its frame
decisions: No spells or abilities are used; both players pass priority with an empty stack.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears, with mana cost {1}{G}, is green and only green.

variants.label: two_colors
variants.delta: A's permanent is Watchwolf (mana cost {G}{W}) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Watchwolf is green and white.

variants.label: hybrid
variants.delta: A's permanent is Kitchen Finks (mana cost {1}{G/W}{G/W}) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Kitchen Finks is green and white.

variants.label: phyrexian
variants.delta: A's permanent is Birthing Pod (an artifact with mana cost {3}{G/P}) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Birthing Pod is green although it is an artifact.

variants.label: no_colored_symbol
variants.delta: A's permanent is Wurmcoil Engine (mana cost {6}) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Wurmcoil Engine has no colored symbol in its mana cost and is colorless.

scenarios.forge_notes: Each variant swaps the single permanent on A's battlefield.

scenarios.title: An object with a color indicator is each color the indicator denotes

setup.notes: Dryad Arbor has no mana cost and a green color indicator.

decisions: No spells or abilities are used; both players pass priority with an empty stack.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Dryad Arbor is green and is a land creature, although it has no mana cost.

variants.label: back_face
variants.delta: A's permanent is Delver of Secrets already transformed into Insectile Aberration (no mana cost, blue color indicator) instead of Dryad Arbor.
variants.expected: Insectile Aberration is blue.

variants.label: no_indicator
variants.delta: A's permanent is Forest (no mana cost, no color indicator) instead of Dryad Arbor.
variants.expected: Forest is colorless.

scenarios.forge_notes: Insectile Aberration is the back face of the card Forge names Delver of Secrets; the puzzle state must put it on the battlefield transformed.

scenarios.title: Effects can change an object's color, add a color, or make it colorless
decisions: A casts Prismatic Lace targeting Grizzly Bears, choosing blue only, tapping one Island.
Both players pass priority; Prismatic Lace resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes blue only; its green is replaced.

variants.label: colorless
variants.delta: A casts Moonlace targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping one Island, instead of casting Prismatic Lace.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes colorless.

variants.label: added_color
variants.delta: A casts Painter's Servant (tapping two Islands) and chooses blue as it enters, instead of casting Prismatic Lace.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is green and blue; blue is added to its green.

variants.label: no_effect
variants.delta: A casts no spell; both players pass priority with an empty stack instead of A casting Prismatic Lace.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears stays green and only green; Ornithopter stays colorless.

scenarios.forge_notes: Prismatic Lace and Moonlace apply a permanent-duration Animate effect that overwrites colors. Painter's Servant's static ability adds the chosen color to every permanent, so with it on the battlefield Ornithopter and Painter's Servant itself are blue too.

scenarios.title: A spell's mana value is the total mana in its mana cost, and a Phyrexian symbol counts as 1

setup.notes: Counterbalance is on A's battlefield. A's library is listed top card first. Whenever B casts a spell, A reveals the top card of A's library, and the spell is countered if its mana value equals the revealed card's. The revealed card stays on top.

decisions: B casts Hill Giant ({3}{R}), tapping four Mountains.
Counterbalance triggers; A chooses to reveal the top card of A's library, Giant Spider (mana value 4).
Both players pass priority; the Counterbalance trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Hill Giant has mana value 4, the same as Giant Spider, so it is countered and put into B's graveyard.

variants.label: different_value
variants.delta: B casts Grizzly Bears ({1}{G}), tapping Forest and a Mountain, instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has mana value 2, not 4, so it is not countered and resolves onto B's battlefield.

variants.label: phyrexian_symbol
variants.delta: B casts Birthing Pod ({3}{G/P}), tapping three Mountains and paying 2 life for {G/P}, instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Birthing Pod has mana value 4 although only three mana were spent, so it is countered and put into B's graveyard; B is at 18 life.

scenarios.forge_notes: Counterbalance's reveal is optional; the scenario has A reveal.

scenarios.title: An object with no mana cost has mana value 0

setup.notes: Counterbalance is on A's battlefield. A's library is listed top card first. Whenever B casts a spell, A reveals the top card of A's library, and the spell is countered if its mana value equals the revealed card's. The revealed card stays on top. Dryad Arbor has no mana cost.

decisions: B casts Ornithopter ({0}).
Counterbalance triggers; A chooses to reveal the top card of A's library, Dryad Arbor (no mana cost).
Both players pass priority; the Counterbalance trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Dryad Arbor has mana value 0, the same as Ornithopter, so Ornithopter is countered and put into B's graveyard.

variants.label: nonzero_value
variants.delta: B casts Grizzly Bears ({1}{G}), tapping Forest and Mountain, instead of Ornithopter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has mana value 2, not 0, so it is not countered and resolves onto B's battlefield.

scenarios.title: A transformed nonmodal double-faced permanent keeps its front face's mana value, and a copy of it has mana value 0

setup.notes: Huntmaster of the Fells ({2}{R}{G}) is on B's battlefield transformed to Ravager of the Fells. Smother can target only a creature with mana value 3 or less. A has priority with Smother in hand and both Swamps untapped.

decisions: A considers casting Smother ({1}{B}) at B's creatures; the verdict is read before any mana is spent.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Ravager of the Fells has mana value 4, the mana value of Huntmaster of the Fells, so it is not a legal target; Smother has no legal target and cannot be cast.

variants.label: copy
variants.delta: B also controls a Clone that entered as a copy of Ravager of the Fells.
variants.expected: The Clone copy has mana value 0, so it is a legal target; Smother can be cast targeting it, and Ravager of the Fells is still not a legal target.

scenarios.forge_notes: The puzzle state puts Huntmaster of the Fells on the battlefield transformed. Ravager of the Fells is its alternate face, so Forge's card name for it is Huntmaster of the Fells.

scenarios.title: A melded permanent's mana value is the combined mana value of its front faces, and a copy of it has mana value 0

setup.notes: Graf Rats ({1}{B}) and Midnight Scavengers ({4}{B}) are melded into Chittering Host on B's battlefield; the permanent is listed as Graf Rats, the front card of the meld pair. Smother can target only a creature with mana value 3 or less. A has priority with Smother in hand and both Swamps untapped.

decisions: A considers casting Smother ({1}{B}) at B's creatures; the verdict is read before any mana is spent.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Chittering Host has mana value 7 (2 + 5), so it is not a legal target; Smother has no legal target and cannot be cast.

variants.label: unmelded
variants.delta: Graf Rats and Midnight Scavengers are two separate creatures on B's battlefield instead of the melded Chittering Host.
variants.expected: Graf Rats (mana value 2) is a legal target and Midnight Scavengers (mana value 5) is not; Smother can be cast targeting Graf Rats.

variants.label: copy
variants.delta: B also controls a Clone that entered as a copy of Chittering Host.
variants.expected: The Clone copy has mana value 0, so it is a legal target; Smother can be cast targeting it, and Chittering Host is still not a legal target.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's script graf_rats_chittering_host.txt holds Graf Rats with Chittering Host as the meld alternate. The puzzle state must put the melded permanent on the battlefield; Forge's mana value for melded permanents and their copies is not confirmed.

scenarios.title: A split card's mana value is both halves combined off the stack, and the cast half's (or both halves' if fused) on the stack

setup.notes: Counterbalance is on A's battlefield. A's library is listed top card first. Whenever B casts a spell, A reveals the top card of A's library, and the spell is countered if its mana value equals the revealed card's. The revealed card stays on top. The card named Wear in the zones is the split card Wear // Tear, with halves Wear ({1}{R}) and Tear ({W}). Its mana value in the library is 3. A also controls Pacifism enchanting A's Ornithopter.

decisions: B casts Gray Ogre ({2}{R}), tapping Mountain, Mountain and Forest.
Counterbalance triggers; A chooses to reveal the top card of A's library, Wear // Tear.
Both players pass priority; the Counterbalance trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Wear // Tear in the library has mana value 3, the same as Gray Ogre, so Gray Ogre is countered and put into B's graveyard.

variants.label: half_value_not_used
variants.delta: B casts Grizzly Bears ({1}{G}), tapping Forest and a Mountain, instead of Gray Ogre.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has mana value 2, which is Wear's half alone but not the card's, so it is not countered and resolves onto B's battlefield.

variants.label: one_half_cast
variants.delta: B casts only the Wear half of Wear // Tear targeting Ornithopter, tapping two Mountains, instead of Gray Ogre.
variants.expected: On the stack the spell has mana value 2, that of Wear alone, not 3, so it is not countered and resolves: Ornithopter is destroyed and Pacifism goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: fused
variants.delta: B casts Wear // Tear fused, Wear targeting Ornithopter and Tear targeting Pacifism, tapping two Mountains and Plains, instead of Gray Ogre.
variants.expected: On the stack the fused spell has mana value 3 (2 + 1), the same as the revealed card, so it is countered and put into B's graveyard; Ornithopter and Pacifism stay on A's battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge names a split card by its first half's Name: line, so Wear // Tear appears as 'Wear' in zones; its second half is the ALTERNATE Name: line.

scenarios.title: X counts as 0 in a mana value off the stack and as the chosen number on the stack

setup.notes: Counterbalance is on A's battlefield. A's library is listed top card first. Whenever B casts a spell, A reveals the top card of A's library, and the spell is countered if its mana value equals the revealed card's. The revealed card stays on top. The top card of A's library is Fireball ({X}{R}), so its mana value there is 1.

decisions: B casts Lightning Bolt ({R}) targeting A, tapping one Mountain.
Counterbalance triggers; A chooses to reveal the top card of A's library, Fireball.
Both players pass priority; the Counterbalance trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Fireball in the library has mana value 1 (X is 0), the same as Lightning Bolt, so Lightning Bolt is countered and put into B's graveyard; A stays at 20 life.

variants.label: x_equals_3
variants.delta: B casts Fireball with X=3 targeting A, tapping four Mountains, instead of Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: On the stack Fireball has mana value 4 (X is 3), not 1, so it is not countered and resolves: A takes 3 damage and is at 17 life.

variants.label: x_equals_0
variants.delta: B casts Fireball with X=0 targeting A, tapping one Mountain, instead of Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: On the stack Fireball has mana value 1 (X is 0), the same as the revealed Fireball, so it is countered and put into B's graveyard; A stays at 20 life.

scenarios.title: A hybrid symbol contributes its largest component to mana value

setup.notes: Counterbalance is on A's battlefield. A's library is listed top card first. Whenever B casts a spell, A reveals the top card of A's library, and the spell is countered if its mana value equals the revealed card's. The revealed card stays on top. Beseech the Queen costs {2/B}{2/B}{2/B}.

decisions: B casts Beseech the Queen, paying {B} for each of its three {2/B} symbols and tapping three Swamps.
Counterbalance triggers; A chooses to reveal the top card of A's library, Craw Wurm (mana value 6).
Both players pass priority; the Counterbalance trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Beseech the Queen has mana value 6 (2 + 2 + 2) although only three mana were spent, the same as Craw Wurm, so it is countered and put into B's graveyard.

variants.label: smaller_value
variants.delta: B casts Giant Spider ({3}{G}), tapping three Swamps and Forest, instead of Beseech the Queen.
variants.expected: Giant Spider has mana value 4, not 6, so it is not countered and resolves onto B's battlefield.

variants.label: revealed_spent_amount
variants.delta: The top card of A's library is Gray Ogre (mana value 3, the amount of mana actually spent) instead of Craw Wurm.
variants.expected: Beseech the Queen has mana value 6, not 3, so it is not countered and resolves; B searches an empty library and finds nothing.
